title: Version Contract Exerciser and Graceful Deprecation Lab
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Build a reproducible, automated "contract exerciser" and 'graceful deprecation lab' that can exercise combinations of API versions, behavior flags, streaming modes, tool/function calls, and structured-output schemas to detect regressions and generate migration guidance.

Why: Recent subtle regressions across streaming+tool-calls and structured outputs have made deprecations risky for customers. We need a deterministic harness that: (1) differentiates behavior changes vs acceptable variance, (2) produces actionable diffs and suggested flag toggles, and (3) powers canary rollouts and nightly regression gates.

Scope and deliverables (MVP):
- Contract Exerciser harness (Go + Python runners) that can run a configurable matrix: API version (v1,v1.1,v2), streaming modes (chunked/frame/delta), tool-call invocation patterns (sync/async), and structured-output schemas (json-schema variants).
- A set of canonical prompt+tool scenarios (30 total) that cover edge cases: incremental token emissions, out-of-order tool call metadata, partial JSON outputs, and mixed text+structured frames.
- Regression comparator that computes: shape diffs, schema violations, token-level edit distance, semantic equivalence score (embedding-based), and latency/cost delta.
- Telemetry plumbing for experiment runs: per-test metrics pushed to observability (Grafana/Prometheus) and aggregated run reports stored in S3.
- Migration guidance generator: given a failing test, emit a short migration note (1-3 lines) with recommended behavior flags, wrapper shim, or client-side change.
- Opt-in runtime shim prototype that can translate legacy streaming frames into v2 structured-frame format for clients that cannot upgrade immediately.
- CI integration: nightly matrix runs and pre-release regression gates for runtime-2.0.

Success metrics:
- Detects 95% of historical regression incidents from past 12 months when replayed in the harness.
- Migration guidance reduces manual triage time by 60% (measured by support/SE feedback).
- Nightly regression false-positive rate < 5% after tuning.

Non-goals for MVP:
- Full end-to-end client SDK migrations (only provide examples).
- Production-ready, high-performance shim (prototype only).

Risks and mitigations:
- Flaky tests due to nondeterministic model outputs: mitigate with seed control for deterministics models where available, semantic scoring thresholds, and multiple-run aggregation.
- Telemetry cost: sample runs for long sequences and store aggregated metrics only.
- Overfitting migration advice: include a manual review step in the first rollout phase.

Next milestones:
1) 2026-02-28: PoC harness capable of running a 3x3x3 matrix and generating run reports.
2) 2026-03-10: Telemetry + comparator implemented; dry-run against 12 replay cases.
3) 2026-03-24: Opt-in runtime shim prototype + migration guidance generator.
4) 2026-03-31: CI integration and gating jobs for runtime-2.0 RC.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run a configurable matrix across at least API v1 and v2, and produce a machine-readable run report.
Comparator computes schema violations and semantic equivalence scores; tests return deterministic PASS/FAIL under defined thresholds.
Nightly job pushes aggregated metrics to observability and stores report artifacts in S3.
Migration guidance generator produces human-readable suggestions for failing tests in >70% of cases and includes a confidence score.
Opt-in runtime shim can translate legacy streaming frames to v2 format for 3 canonical scenarios and is documented in the runbook.
